title: viola mirabilis var. langsdorffii
intro: Viola mirabilis var. langsdorffii, commonly known as Langsdorff's violet, is a plant species belonging to the violet family (Violaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Langsdorff's violet include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include iridoids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and anxiolytic effects.
